Package com.hkust.marketplace.services

Record Class Deal

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.hkust.marketplace.services.Deal
Record Components:
offer - the deal itself: type, status, terms and the seller's counter, if any
listing - the listing the deal is on
sellerName - the seller's full name, or the username if the account was deleted
canBeMarkedComplete - true for an accepted price offer or claim that is not completed yet (UC7 step 3; Special Requirement 1)
canBeReturned - true for an accepted borrow request whose item has not been returned and whose due date has not come yet (UC7 A2; Special Requirement 3)
canBeReviewed - true for a completed deal that the buyer has not reviewed yet (UC7 Special Requirement 6; UC10 step 2)
public record Deal(Offer offer, Listing listing, String sellerName, boolean canBeMarkedComplete, boolean canBeReturned, boolean canBeReviewed) extends Record
One of the buyer's deals as My Deals shows it (UC7 step 2): the price offer, borrow request or claim, its listing and seller, and what the buyer can do with it right now. The three "can" answers are worked out by MyDealsService from the rules of the use cases, so a screen only shows the matching buttons and never decides.
